cells.value: Opening of circuit breaker Da10
Initial condition -Converter BK02501 is off and circuit breaker Da10 is opened.

(a) Disconnect connector “A02-P02A" from the Extension board module ''YJC0487/01 A02” of the converter and short pins 2 (-) and 3 (+). (b) Check "CLOSING AUTHORISATION” lamp for Da10 is available and make circuit breaker Da10. Remove the shorting. (c) Check Da10 Opens.On completion reconnect connector “A02-P02A”.
Indication of the position of circuit breaker Da10

(a) Disconnect connector “A02-P01A” and "A02-P01B” from the Extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” of the converter. (b) Check non continuity between pin 2 of connector “A02-P01 A” and pin 2 of connector “A02-P01B”.

(a) Disconnect “A02-P02A” from the extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” and short pins 2 (-) and 3 (+) of connector “A02-P02A”. Check “CLOSING AUTHORISATION” lamp is available. Make circuit breaker Da10 in BK02600. (b) Check continuity between pin 2 of connector “A02- P01 A” and pin 2 of connector “A02-P01B”. (c) Drop circuit breaker Da10 and revert back to initial conditions.
Indication of the converter synchronised status(CLOSING AUTHORISATION of Da10)
Initial condition- Remove fuses F003 and F004 in BK02600 and connect a 115V AC voltage source to supply the 24V DC internal power supply and to simulate the activation of converter BK02500.

(a) In the converter BK02500, Disconnect “A02-P02A” from the extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” of the converter and short pins 2 (-) and 3 (+) of connector “A02-P02A”. Check "CLOSING AUTHORISATION" lamp for Da20 is available and Make circuit breaker Da20. In the converter BK02501, Disconnect “A02-P02B” from the extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” and short pins 2 and 3 of connector “A02-P02B”. (b) Check “CLOSING AUTHORISATION” lamp for Da10 is available (c) Remove the short and the lamp for Da 10 turns off. Reconnect connector “A02-P02B”. Test continued to next section.
Opening of circuit breaker Da20
(a) Remove the short between pins 2(-) and pins 3(+) of connector “A02-P02A”.Check Da20 Opens. (b) On completion remove the short and reconnect the connector.
Indication of the position of circuit breaker Da20
(a) Disconnect connector “A02-P01A” and "A02-P01B” from the Extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02”. (b) Check non continuity between pin 2 of connector “A02-P01 A” and pin 2 of connector “A02-P01B”.

(a) Disconnect “A02-P02A” from the extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” and short pins 2 (-) and 3 (+) of connector “A02-P02A”. Check “CLOSING AUTHORISATION” lamp is available. Make circuit breaker Da20 in BK02600. (b) Check continuity between pin 2 of connector “A02- P01 A” and pin 2 of connector “A02-P01B”. (c) Drop circuit breaker Da20 and revert back to initial conditions.
Indication of the converter synchronised status(CLOSING AUTHORISATION of Da20)

(a) Initial conditions. BK02500 is off Remove voltage source to supply the 24V DC and replace fuses F001 and F002 in BK02600. Start converter BK02501 (BK 02500 is off). Select local control mode on control panel BK02501. Make Da10 breaker. (b) In the converter BK02500, Disconnect “A02-P02A” from the extension board module “YJC0487/01 A02” of the converter and short pins 2 (-) and 3 (+) of connector “A02-P02A”. (c) Check “CLOSING AUTHORISATION” lamp for Da20 is available (d) Remove the shorting and the lamp turns off. Reconnect connector “A02-P02B”. Stop converter BK02501. Remove the 115V AC power supply and replace fuses F003 and F004.
